name: media_gallery_filterable
title: Media Gallery Filterable
description: Photo gallery of a project (based on project_media_gallery's folder finder): one filter chip per gallery folder with its count ("All" first), a grid with a larger first frame, a label per tile (folder + number), "Showing X of Y" with Load more / Show all, and the popup gallery of the visible frames. Default folder: media (media/<sub folders>). A <section> of its own with a section_head.
